moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio s-framerbouncy, written here): Target moves 0 → 1 on stiffness 400, damping 17, mass 1 (damping ratio 0.43): 22.9 % overshoot, within 1 % by ~550 ms. Kit form: springk(400, 17) over 0.55 s. Site rule: a strong, fast spring with a clear rebound. Site demo: the target moves 102 px beside the response graph, with overshoot and settle readouts. Params: stiffness (400) · damping (17) · duration (0.55 s). A strong, fast spring (400 / 17, ratio 0.43): about 23 % past with a clear rebound, ~0.55 s.
